en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. It was narrated to us by Hamzah b. Muhammad al-Alawi from Ali b. Ibrahim from his father Ibrahim b. Hashim from Muhammad b. Abi ’Umayr from U’yaynah Bayaa’ al-Qasab from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who goes for Ziyarat of Imam Husain (a.s.) knowing his right Allah writes it among Aa’la-e-Illiyeen.”
